summary: Make per-agent queue reads avoid sorting and decoding observation history for the existence check.

replay.detail: Queue joins and canonical move replay are unchanged; no claims are replayed during deployment.

schema.detail: Reuses the existing indexed newest-claim ID lookup. No tables, indexes, migrations or database version changes.

rules.detail: No claim rules or compatibility digest changes.

compatibility.detail: The agent-queue HTTP response and missing-agent behavior are unchanged for a web client. No schema or generated-client change.

downtime.detail: Normal deployment restart only; no backfill or startup work.

recovery.detail: All queue data remains derived from current store reads, without a new cache. Rollback needs no data conversion.
